It handles complex collecting, verifying, and managing sensitive personal information to stay focused on building products.

about_short_description.short_description: Persona is an identity verification and management platform that enables businesses to automate and streamline their verification processes.

product.name: Persona Identity Platform
product.description: A cloud-based identity verification and management platform for collecting, verifying, enriching, and managing identity information across customer and business life cycles.

product.name: Verification Services
product.description: A collection of automated services for verifying people, documents, contact details, and businesses using government IDs, biometrics, databases, digital IDs, and NFC-enabled credentials.

product.name: Dynamic Flow
product.description: A no-code system for creating identity verification journeys that adjust data collection and verification requirements based on user preferences, business rules, and risk signals.

product.name: Workflows
product.description: A workflow automation product for triggering identity processes, combining data sources, applying decision rules, and initiating actions across Persona and connected business systems.

product.name: Case Management
product.description: A configurable case management system for investigating identity and fraud events, coordinating reviewers, applying decisions, and maintaining audit records.

product.name: Risk & Screening Reports
product.description: Reports and enrichment services that assess individuals and businesses using watchlists, adverse media, contact risk, address data, social media, and business-related signals.
